name: Norma Health
statusNote: Norma Health is in App Store review. This page will link to the App Store as soon as the app is available.
summary: Food, activity and weight tracking for iPhone.
description: One screen shows what you ate, how you moved and how your weight is trending against your plan.

groups.title: Food
groups.body: Log a meal from recent foods, favorites and saved meals, or search more than 5,000 foods. Each day and week shows calories and protein against your plan.

groups.title: Activity
groups.body: Record walks, rides and runs, or follow a strength routine from the built-in exercise library. The week shows your minutes and the sessions still to go.

groups.title: Progress
groups.body: Weigh in and follow a 7-day average that smooths out daily swings. The chart shows where your plan expects you to be and whether you are on pace.

privacy: No ads, no tracking and no selling of your data. Export everything or delete your account at any time from inside the app.
disclaimer: Norma Health is a planning aid, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before changing your diet or exercise.
